title: Pony.ai unveils autonomous electric truck for logistics fleets
summary: Pony.ai has unveiled a fourth-generation autonomous electric truck for logistics fleets, developed in partnership with GAC Commercial Vehicle, at IAA Transportation 2026. The L4 heavy rig builds on GAC's T9 battery-electric truck architecture and is designed for freight supply chains.
problem_solved: Addresses the logistics industry's need for autonomous freight transportation to reduce operational costs and improve supply chain efficiency.
why_valuable: Represents a significant advancement toward commercializing autonomous trucking, potentially revolutionizing freight logistics with reduced labor costs and 24/7 operational capability.
